title: Field: cursor.page
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer query cursor.page field.
meaning: Zero-based page index for paginated buyer search.

invariants.label: Pagination only
invariants.value: Affects result paging, not filtering semantics.

text:
# cursor.page

TL;DR:
- cursor.page is a zero-based result page index.

What it means:
- Use it to move through a paginated result set.

Agent hint:
- Start with page 0 unless the workflow is explicitly continuing from a later page.
